items.question: Are you a lender?
items.answer: No. FV Funding is a business funding advisor. We prepare your file and approach banks and NBFCs; the lender alone decides whether to sanction.

items.question: Do you guarantee approval?
items.answer: No one honestly can. What we do is remove the avoidable reasons a file gets declined: the wrong lender, the wrong product, or numbers presented poorly.

items.question: Do you handle home, car or personal loans?
items.answer: No. We work only on facilities that run and grow businesses.

items.question: Which businesses do you work with?
items.answer: Manufacturers and processors, traders and distributors, service businesses and professional firms, exporters and importers, and growing companies or funded startups that already have revenue.

items.question: What happens in the free 30-minute review?
items.answer: We understand your requirement, timeline and existing borrowings, and tell you which type of facility is likely to fit and what we would need to prepare it.

items.question: Do I need all my documents before booking?
items.answer: No. Book first. The checklist on this site shows what helps; we will tell you what else is needed after the first call.

items.question: How long does funding take?
items.answer: It depends on the facility, the lender and how complete the file is. A well-prepared file moves faster at every lender; we give you a realistic timeline after the diagnosis.

items.question: Can you help with renewal of an existing limit?
items.answer: Yes. We prepare renewal and enhancement files so an existing limit is kept or increased rather than cut.

items.question: Which banks and NBFCs do you work with?
items.answer: We approach banks and NBFCs whose lending criteria fit your case. We tell you which lender before any application is made.

items.question: Will approaching many lenders hurt my credit score?
items.answer: Each formal application can lead to a credit enquiry. That is why we shortlist lenders before applying instead of sending the file everywhere.

items.question: Can you help with government schemes and subsidies?
items.answer: Yes: capital and interest subsidies, CGTMSE, and central and Gujarat incentives. We check eligibility and handle the filing. The government agency decides and pays, usually after disbursement.

items.question: What do you do with my documents?
items.answer: We use them only to assess and prepare your funding file, share them only with lenders you have agreed to, and never collect financial documents through this website.
